rows.name:
The Homs of the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God Realm[/System:Color] face a decisive battle[XENO:n ]
against the army invading from the [System:Color name=s1 ]Machine God Realm[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Defeat the oncoming [System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldiers[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
with the hero's sword, the Monado!

Shulk and his best friend Rein were scavenging wreckage[XENO:n ]
when monsters attacked them at the [System:Color name=s1 ]Machine Soldier Wreckage[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Join forces with Rein and defeat the [System:Color name=s2 ]monsters[/System:Color]!

The monsters have been driven off, but[XENO:n ]
Rein's Defence Force is due to assemble soon.[XENO:n ]
Return to their home town, [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color].

After parting ways with Rein, Shulk decides[XENO:n ]
to return to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color] alone.[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Military District[/System:Color], to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color].

After parting ways with Rein, Shulk decides[XENO:n ]
to return to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color] alone.[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Military District[/System:Color], to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color].

Fiorung has prepared a meal for Shulk.[XENO:n ]
To deliver the dish she's proud of,[XENO:n ]
find Shulk somewhere in [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color].

According to Dikson,[XENO:n ]
Shulk seems to be at the park on the hill.[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Outlook Park[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color].

Part of the Giant God's body fell from high above. Leave the[XENO:n ]
park, outside the falling-debris interception zone, and return[XENO:n ]
to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Military District[/System:Color], to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color].

To retrieve ether cylinders,[XENO:n ]
the group is heading to [System:Color name=s1 ]Mag Mell Ruins[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color], where the ruins lie.

Fiorung has joined Shulk and Rein.[XENO:n ]
Make your way through [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
to [System:Color name=s1 ]Mag Mell Ruins[/System:Color] deep within.

[System:Color name=s1 ]Mag Mell Ruins[/System:Color] seem to be an ancient vessel.[XENO:n ]
The ether cylinders are in the ship's hangar.[XENO:n ]
Head deep into the ruins to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Cylinder Hangar[/System:Color].

At the [System:Color name=s1 ]Cylinder Hangar[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
mysterious weapons suddenly attack Shulk's party.[XENO:n ]
Defeat these mysterious weapons, the [System:Color name=s2 ]Ancient Machines[/System:Color]!

Machine God Soldiers launch a surprise attack on [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Their army was supposedly wiped out a year ago[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Hurry back to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color].

Shulk's party encounters Machine God Soldiers in the[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Commercial District[/System:Color]. They cannot let these Homs-eating[XENO:n ]
soldiers run rampant. Defeat the [System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldier M63[/System:Color]!

The group has managed to stop the soldier, but[XENO:n ]
no weapon besides the Monado can defeat them. Head to[XENO:n ]
the [System:Color name=s1 ]Military District[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color] for the Monado.

Shulk's party could only watch the Defence Force[XENO:n ]
be wiped out. No weapon besides the Monado[XENO:n ]
can defeat Machine God Soldiers. Head to the[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Military District[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color] for the Monado.

Rubble blocks the [System:Color name=s1 ]Weapon Dev. Lab[/System:Color] where the Monado lies.[XENO:n ]
Perhaps the Doora self-propelled gun can defeat them[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 9[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Residential District[/System:Color] to reach the Doora.

Machine God Soldiers block their way at the [System:Color name=s1 ]Central Plaza[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Shulk and Rein let Fiorung escape ahead of them.[XENO:n ]
Hold back the advance of the [System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldiers[/System:Color]!

Dunban rushes to their aid with the Monado.[XENO:n ]
Now they can fight the Machine God Soldiers.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado's power to wipe out the [System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldiers[/System:Color]!

Rubble blocks the bridge from the [System:Color name=s1 ]Central District[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Residential District[/System:Color]. The group fears[XENO:n ]
for Fiorung, who went ahead. Head through the[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Commercial District[/System:Color] towards the [System:Color name=s1 ]Residential District[/System:Color].

With resolve, Shulk takes up the Monado.[XENO:n ]
But there's no time to think right now.[XENO:n ]
Hurry to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Residential District[/System:Color], where Fiorung is.

A black Machine God Soldier with a face blocks the way.[XENO:n ]
Fiorung is just beyond it.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado to defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Black Face[/System:Color]!

The Doora carrying Fiorung has been crushed.[XENO:n ]
They can never forgive [System:Color name=s2 ]Black Face[/System:Color] for this.[XENO:n ]
Even if the Monado won't work, they must fight!

To find clues about [System:Color name=s2 ]Black Face[/System:Color], head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color] lies far beyond the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
First, go through [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color] to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].

To find clues about [System:Color name=s2 ]Black Face[/System:Color], head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color] lies far beyond the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
First, go through [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color] to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].

A caravan from [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color] has put up[XENO:n ]
ether lamps, which Shulk's party has discovered.[XENO:n ]
Follow the lamps out of [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color].

After waking from a strange dream,[XENO:n ]
Shulk finds himself surrounded by monsters.[XENO:n ]
Help Rein and wipe out the [System:Color name=s2 ]swarm of Spides[/System:Color]!

Shulk saw Rein attacked by a monster in a vision.[XENO:n ]
He's not sure what it foretells.[XENO:n ]
For now, press on through [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color].

Rein is entangled in a monster's web.[XENO:n ]
Could this be what Shulk saw in his vision[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Find Rein somewhere in [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color].

Rein is spotted at [System:Color name=s1 ]Vilia Lake[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
He's being chased by monsters.[XENO:n ]
Climb the vines at [System:Color name=s1 ]Vilia Lake[/System:Color] and follow Rein.

A vision at [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Queen Spider's Den[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
The Monado's new power protects Rein.[XENO:n ]
Use this power to defeat the [System:Color name=s2 ]Spide Queen[/System:Color]!

Having changed the future with this new power,[XENO:n ]
Shulk's party sets out once more for [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Exit the [System:Color name=s1 ]Queen Spider's Den[/System:Color] towards the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].

Shulk's party emerges from [System:Color name=s1 ]Tephra Cave[/System:Color] onto [System:Color name=s1 ]Kneecap Hill[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Their destination, [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color], lies beyond the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head from [System:Color name=s1 ]Kneecap Hill[/System:Color] to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].

Shulk's party notices black smoke on [System:Color name=s1 ]Gaur Plain[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Someone might be out on the vast [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head towards the smoke to investigate its cause.

A vision from an abandoned buggy showed[XENO:n ]
a boy being attacked by monsters beside water.[XENO:n ]
Search for the water on the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color] and save him.

The boy has been found at [System:Color name=s1 ]Rho Oasis[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Just as in the vision, he's under attack by monsters.[XENO:n ]
Save the boy and defeat the [System:Color name=s2 ]Berserk Ardun[/System:Color]!

The boy's name is Juujuu.[XENO:n ]
He says he lives in a camp nearby.[XENO:n ]
Head to the camp near [System:Color name=s1 ]Kamos Guidepost[/System:Color].

The group meets Juujuu's older sister, Carna.[XENO:n ]
It seems [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color] was attacked as well.[XENO:n ]
Speak to Carna to learn more.

A vision of Juujuu and Carna attacked by a Machine God[XENO:n ]
Soldier. At this rate, Juujuu is in danger.[XENO:n ]
Leave the [System:Color name=s1 ]Evac Ship Camp[/System:Color] and follow Juujuu.

Juujuu has sped off in his buggy.[XENO:n ]
In a buggy, he'll surely use [System:Color name=s1 ]Raguel Bridge[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]the Giant God's Leg[/System:Color], to [System:Color name=s1 ]Raguel Bridge[/System:Color].

The valley in the vision is [System:Color name=s1 ]Spiral Valley[/System:Color] on the[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color]. Juujuu seems to be heading there.[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Spiral Valley[/System:Color] to prevent that future.

[System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color] lies beyond [System:Color name=s1 ]Maguel Road[/System:Color], but[XENO:n ]
the vision tells them Juujuu is in the valley.[XENO:n ]
Find [System:Color name=s1 ]Spiral Valley[/System:Color] beyond the road.

A tentacled Machine God Soldier is at [System:Color name=s1 ]Spiral Valley[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
on the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color]. It has captured Juujuu.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado's power to defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldier M71[/System:Color]!

At the top of [System:Color name=s1 ]Spiral Valley[/System:Color] on the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldier M71[/System:Color] has fled after losing its tentacles.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado's power to defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldier M71[/System:Color]!

A faced Machine God Soldier appears at [System:Color name=s1 ]Spiral Valley[/System:Color] on[XENO:n ]
the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Leg[/System:Color]. It's not the black one, but a fight[XENO:n ]
is unavoidable. Defeat the faced soldier, [System:Color name=s2 ]Mysterious Face[/System:Color]!

To reach [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color], go through [System:Color name=s1 ]Maguel Road[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
and past [System:Color name=s1 ]Kasharpa Falls[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color] to rescue Juujuu.

Machine God Soldiers have fortified [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
The only way inside is via the [System:Color name=s1 ]underground tunnels[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Enter through the [System:Color name=s1 ]Drainage Outlet[/System:Color] on the [System:Color name=s1 ]Splintered Path[/System:Color].

The party has entered the [System:Color name=s1 ]underground tunnels[/System:Color] of [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
To find Juujuu and the colony's people,[XENO:n ]
follow the [System:Color name=s1 ]underground tunnels[/System:Color] to its deepest point.

In [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]underground tunnels[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
the group meets Odama fighting Machine God Soldiers.[XENO:n ]
Help Odama and wipe out the [System:Color name=s2 ]Machine God Soldiers[/System:Color]!

The Homs prisoners in [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color] are apparently being taken[XENO:n ]
to the centre of the mine.[XENO:n ]
Follow the [System:Color name=s1 ]underground tunnels[/System:Color] to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Central Pit[/System:Color].

Shulk and Odama have parted on bad terms.[XENO:n ]
Though going separately, navigate [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color]'s[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]underground tunnels[/System:Color] towards the [System:Color name=s1 ]Central Pit[/System:Color].

The group reaches [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Central Pit[/System:Color], but[XENO:n ]
there's no sign of Juujuu or the colonists.[XENO:n ]
Descend the [System:Color name=s1 ]Central Pit[/System:Color] to the lowest level.

On the lowest level of [System:Color name=s1 ]Colony 6[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]underground tunnels[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s2 ]Zord[/System:Color] is lying in wait.[XENO:n ]
Defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Zord[/System:Color] to save Juujuu!

They have succeeded in changing the future.[XENO:n ]
With [System:Color name=s2 ]Zord[/System:Color] defeated, Juujuu has been rescued.[XENO:n ]
Escape the mine via the [System:Color name=s1 ]Freight Elevator[/System:Color].

[System:Color name=s2 ]Zord[/System:Color] has pursued them from the current of ether.[XENO:n ]
The Monado can cut through ether-corroded armour.[XENO:n ]
Defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Zord[/System:Color] for good this time!

Shulk's party escapes the mine, but[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s2 ]Black Face[/System:Color] and the Machine God Soldiers block their path.[XENO:n ]
Now is the time to avenge Fiorung!

To reach the Giant God's upper reaches, where [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
lies, they must cross the glowing land of [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color]. Go the[XENO:n ]
opposite way from the Giant God's Leg towards [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color].

The Giant God's upper reaches, where [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color] lies,[XENO:n ]
can be reached from deep within glowing [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Make your way to the far end of [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color].

The Giant God's upper reaches, where [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color] lies,[XENO:n ]
can be reached from deep within glowing [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Make your way to the far end of [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color].

The Giant God's upper reaches, where [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color] lies,[XENO:n ]
can be reached from deep within glowing [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Make your way to the far end of [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color].

The [System:Color name=s1 ]Sororal Statues[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
provide the only route to the Giant God's upper reaches.[XENO:n ]
Head to the High Entia ruins, the [System:Color name=s1 ]Sororal Statues[/System:Color].

The [System:Color name=s1 ]Sororal Statues[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color] lead to the upper levels.[XENO:n ]
But the lift to the summit is unusable.[XENO:n ]
Climb the wall to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Statue Summit[/System:Color].

The top of the [System:Color name=s1 ]Sororal Statues[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Satorl Marsh[/System:Color] is the passage[XENO:n ]
linking the Giant God's lower and upper reaches. Enter the[XENO:n ]
ruins from the [System:Color name=s1 ]Statue Summit[/System:Color] and emerge in the upper reaches.

The ruins lead deep into the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Interior[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Pass through the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Interior[/System:Color], inactive since[XENO:n ]
ancient times, to reach the Giant God's upper levels.

Beyond the [System:Color name=s1 ]Giant God's Interior[/System:Color] lies a lush green land.[XENO:n ]
Their destination, [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color], lies on the Giant[XENO:n ]
God's head. Press on to find a way to the head.

This lush green land is [System:Color name=s1 ]Makna Forest[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
It's said to be home to the Nopon.[XENO:n ]
First, look for the Nopon village.

To help the girl they met in [System:Color name=s1 ]Makna Forest[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
the party must find water ether crystals.[XENO:n ]
Search near the [System:Color name=s1 ]Great Makna Falls[/System:Color].

A mysterious boy appears near [System:Color name=s1 ]Great Makna Falls[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
A Telethia attacks—a formidable monster that reads minds.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado's new power to defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Puera Telethia[/System:Color]!

Melia, the girl rescued in [System:Color name=s1 ]Makna Forest[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
offers to guide them to [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color] on the Giant God's head.[XENO:n ]
First, head to the Nopon settlement, [System:Color name=s1 ]Frontier Village[/System:Color].

Shulk's party arrives at [System:Color name=s1 ]Frontier Village[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Melia seems to have reasons for leaving on her own.[XENO:n ]
Find Melia somewhere in the village.

When Shulk's party offers to help Melia,[XENO:n ]
Chief Donga offers to introduce the Nopon hero.[XENO:n ]
Visit the chief on the first floor of [System:Color name=s1 ]Frontier Village[/System:Color].

Shulk's party is introduced to the Nopon hero, Riki.[XENO:n ]
They decide to obtain equipment for him.[XENO:n ]
Get the equipment in [System:Color name=s1 ]Frontier Village[/System:Color] and deliver it to Riki.

The party sets out with Melia and Riki to hunt the Telethia.[XENO:n ]
It apparently rests by ether crystals.[XENO:n ]
Search for ether crystals in [System:Color name=s1 ]Makna Forest[/System:Color].

They find the Telethia in the [System:Color name=s1 ]depths[/System:Color] of [System:Color name=s1 ]Makna Forest[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Melia strikes first, vowing revenge.[XENO:n ]
Help Melia and defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Leone Telethia[/System:Color]!

Deep in [System:Color name=s1 ]Makna Forest[/System:Color], in its [System:Color name=s1 ]depths[/System:Color], the fight goes on.[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s2 ]Leone Telethia[/System:Color] heals its wounds with incredible regeneration.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado's new power to destroy it!

With the Telethia defeated, Melia's mission is complete.[XENO:n ]
Donga has also granted permission to visit [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Speak to Melia somewhere in [System:Color name=s1 ]Frontier Village[/System:Color].

[System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color] is a sealed land.[XENO:n ]
Melia offers to guide them to [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head from the top of [System:Color name=s1 ]Frontier Village[/System:Color] to [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color] with her.

Without permission from the High Entia Emperor,[XENO:n ]
no one can enter the sealed land of [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head to [System:Color name=s1 ]Imperial Capital Achamoth[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color].

To obtain imperial permission for [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color], Melia[XENO:n ]
leaves Shulk's group and goes alone to report to the Emperor.[XENO:n ]
Head to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Audience Chamber[/System:Color], where he awaits.

To obtain imperial permission for [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color], Melia[XENO:n ]
leaves Shulk's group and goes alone to report to the Emperor.[XENO:n ]
Head to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Audience Chamber[/System:Color], where he awaits.

Surrounded by the High Entia imperial guards, Shulk's party[XENO:n ]
is placed under house arrest in [System:Color name=s1 ]Imperial Capital Achamoth[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Talk to the others to assess the situation.

Released from house arrest, Shulk's party[XENO:n ]
agrees to search for a transporter repair worker.[XENO:n ]
Find the missing worker in [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color].

With the incident resolved, the party decides to rest[XENO:n ]
in the capital. Return to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Whitewing Palace[/System:Color] in[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Imperial Capital Achamoth[/System:Color] and speak to the palace attendant.

During Melia's investiture as heir to the throne,[XENO:n ]
masked High Entia infiltrate the [System:Color name=s1 ]Whitewing Palace[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
There is no choice but to fight. Repel the [System:Color name=s2 ]assassins[/System:Color]!

A vision shows danger awaiting Melia on her visit to the tomb.[XENO:n ]
The tomb can be reached from [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color]'s [System:Color name=s1 ]Centre Gate[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Follow Melia to the [System:Color name=s1 ]High Entia Tomb[/System:Color].

Melia visits the tomb for proof of her status as[XENO:n ]
crown princess. In the sealed [System:Color name=s1 ]High Entia Tomb[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
prove her rightful succession and proceed.

To reach the [System:Color name=s1 ]Ceremony Hall[/System:Color], where the imperial ancestor[XENO:n ]
is enshrined, Melia must overcome various trials.[XENO:n ]
Proceed carefully through the [System:Color name=s1 ]High Entia Tomb[/System:Color].

Shulk's group has triggered the defence mechanisms.[XENO:n ]
Follow Melia towards the [System:Color name=s1 ]Ceremony Hall[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
deep within the [System:Color name=s1 ]High Entia Tomb[/System:Color].

A defence mechanism designed to repel intruders[XENO:n ]
blocks the way. Unless they hurry, the vision will[XENO:n ]
come true. Defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Oruga Rufus[/System:Color] to follow Melia!

The [System:Color name=s1 ]Ceremony Hall[/System:Color] seen in the vision is close.[XENO:n ]
But there's no time to dawdle.[XENO:n ]
Hurry to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Ceremony Hall[/System:Color] deep in the [System:Color name=s1 ]High Entia Tomb[/System:Color].

Rushing to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Ceremony Hall[/System:Color] in the [System:Color name=s1 ]High Entia Tomb[/System:Color],[XENO:n ]
the group finds [System:Color name=s2 ]Talco[/System:Color], Melia and a Telethia.[XENO:n ]
Defeat [System:Color name=s2 ]Talco[/System:Color] and [System:Color name=s2 ]Solidum Telethia[/System:Color]!

With the matter settled, Shulk's party returns to the[XENO:n ]
[System:Color name=s1 ]Whitewing Palace[/System:Color], where they are summoned by Emperor Sorean.[XENO:n ]
Head to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Audience Chamber[/System:Color], where Sorean awaits.

Riki suggests going to see Melia.[XENO:n ]
She is probably resting at the [System:Color name=s1 ]Imperial Villa[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Head to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Imperial Villa[/System:Color] in [System:Color name=s1 ]Imperial Capital Achamoth[/System:Color].

An ominous vision, then a sudden alarm.[XENO:n ]
Sorean dies on [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color], and Machine God Soldiers attack[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
Hurry to the [System:Color name=s1 ]Audience Chamber[/System:Color] to stop Sorean.

To protect [System:Color name=s1 ]Imperial Capital Achamoth[/System:Color], Sorean[XENO:n ]
has already departed for [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color].[XENO:n ]
Go out to [System:Color name=s1 ]Eryth Sea[/System:Color] and head for [System:Color name=s1 ]Prison Island[/System:Color].

Approach [System:Color name=s1 ]Soltnar Seal Island[/System:Color] and see what's happening.

become savage [System:Color name=s2 ]Fogbeasts[/System:Color], showing unmistakably

To protect the townspeople, defeat these [System:Color name=s2 ]Fogbeast Armu[/System:Color]!

town for now. But if the rift keeps growing, the
[System:Color name=s2 ]Fogbeasts[/System:Color] will multiply. Return to [System:Color name=s1 ]Tet's Laboratory[/System:Color]
and borrow research that may provide an answer.

sees Tet's research as an obstacle to his beliefs.

residents of [System:Color name=s1 ]Gran Dell[/System:Color] and search for the crystals.
